checks: native navigation starts immediately and keeps current content visible
modified, external, download, new-tab and same-document links keep native behavior
cancelled actions never show navigation progress; stalled navigation remains usable
back-forward restoration resets progress and preserves form drafts
intent prefetch is bounded, deduplicated and excludes external or sensitive routes
data saver, slow connections and offline mode suppress speculative requests
every shared page paints a loading surface before dependencies and defers shared data scripts
legacy regional handlers cannot hide a page or delay its native navigation
Cloudflare fingerprint URLs match the actual asset bytes in root and nested pages
Cloudflare output contains release metadata and excludes backend source and QA artifacts
Worker caches fingerprinted assets immutably while pages and mutable assets revalidate
Worker preserves private, partial, authenticated and error response caching
Worker resolves root, nested and extensionless deep links without masking unknown routes
invalid AI API requests are rejected without inference and never cached
Worker proxy uses the explicit JSON endpoint and a completed analysis envelope
Worker cannot fall through to an unrelated Gradio UI endpoint
Worker rejects interface text, heartbeat-only output, errors and unfinished SSE frames
auth dependencies load locally in parallel; timeout keeps protected contents hidden
auth dependency failures show a useful error on the public sign-in page
sign-in and password forms cannot submit credentials while the client is loading
auth reveals protected content only after membership resolves and clears a late failure panel
sign-in controls become available only after the session client finishes starting
pinned local spreadsheet reader preserves identifiers, quantities and dates
legacy analyst formatting removes active HTML, resource loads and unsafe links
regional pages and built nested pages retain their full module startup lifecycle
brand analysis distinguishes eligible stock, demand and at-risk models without modifying records
